name: ai-travel-planner
description: An agentic, map-first travel planner that schedules a trip around budget, weather, opening hours, travel time, food and personal taste — and rearranges itself when reality changes.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @atp/core && npm run build --workspace @atp/server && npm run build --workspace @atp/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @atp/core && concurrently -n core,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run watch --workspace @atp/core" "npm run dev --workspace @atp/server" "npm run dev --workspace @atp/web"
